review.reviewer: Independent visual reviewer; explicitly loaded image_visual role instructions

objective.evidence: Faceted rectangular perfume bottle, golden liquid, substantial clear crystal cap, brass neck and ivory mesh ribbon are present.

text_facts.evidence: No readable writing, label text or watermark is visible.

composition.evidence: The complete object is visible, but cap, base and rightmost ribbon tip sit close to canvas boundaries. Padding is narrow rather than the explicitly requested generous clearance.

brand_reference.evidence: Warm amber liquid, refractive clear facets, brass hardware and delicate ivory ribbon provide the requested semantic and material equivalence. Different cap geometry and ribbon arrangement are acceptable for fresh generation.

visual_integrity.evidence: Bottle, liquid level, neck, cap and tied ribbon form coherent product geometry; fine ribbon mesh and glass reflections remain legible.

preservation.evidence: Fresh text-only generation; reference pixels and exact silhouette were not preservation targets.

transparency.evidence: Light and dark composites show clean exterior clearance and ribbon contours without a broad halo, backdrop rectangle or cast shadow. Glass facets and ribbon mesh retain useful detail on both backgrounds.

prompt_improvement: Add: Frame the complete bottle and every ribbon tip within the central 80% of the canvas, leaving at least 10% clear transparent margin on every side.
